headline: French 10-year bond yield hits 5% for first time since 2002 amid unrest
detail: Rising bond yields typically make growth stocks, especially tech, less attractive as future earnings are discounted more heavily. This could put pressure on your tech-heavy portfolio, particularly those on margin.
rec: No action. This is a macro trend to monitor, not an immediate trade trigger for a specific holding.

headline: Why SpaceX’s stock is surging — and lifting the broader AI universe along with it
detail: This is a positive catalyst for the "AI universe," which includes many of your tech and chip names. Strong performance in a key AI player can boost sentiment across the sector.
rec: No action. While positive for sentiment, there isn't a specific scanner setup for a new buy that aligns perfectly and isn't "chasing."

headline: SpaceX up 10% in premarket after earnings beat and Musk hints at Tesla tie-up
detail: Reinforces the positive sentiment from the broader AI universe. Strong earnings and potential synergies with Tesla could further fuel the AI/tech rally, potentially benefiting your holdings like QQQ, SMH, and individual tech names.
rec: No action. Similar to the other AI headline, this is a positive sentiment driver but doesn't provide a specific, low-risk entry for a new position.
